candidate_sentence_map.S1: Infortar Group reported a significant improvement in profitability in the first half of 2026 despite broadly stable revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Six-month revenue decreased 0.6% year on year to EUR 945.9 million, while EBITDA increased 30.8% to EUR 111.2 million and the EBITDA margin rose from 8.9% to 11.8%.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Operating profit almost doubled, increasing 93.6% to EUR 51.1 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Profit before tax rose to EUR 27.2 million from EUR 2.7 million, and the Group generated net profit of EUR 7.2 million compared with a EUR 14.4 million loss in the prior-year period.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Net profit attributable to the parent’s owners was EUR 15.2 million, versus a EUR 2.5 million loss, resulting in basic earnings per share of EUR 0.74 compared with negative EUR 0.12.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Second-quarter revenue declined 12.6% to EUR 440.9 million, but gross profit increased to EUR 59.4 million from EUR 55.7 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: EBITDA rose 11.8% to EUR 64.2 million, operating profit increased 9.8% to EUR 29.7 million, and net profit reached EUR 1.9 million compared with EUR 0.2 million in Q2 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The improvement reflected stronger performance across all segments, particularly supporting businesses, which moved from a EUR 4.4 million EBITDA loss in the first half of 2025 to EUR 5.6 million of EBITDA in 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Energy EBITDA increased to EUR 59.9 million from EUR 51.7 million, while maritime transport EBITDA rose to EUR 39.3 million from EUR 33.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Real estate EBITDA increased to EUR 6.5 million from EUR 4.4 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Energy revenue declined as Elenger’s gas and electricity sales volumes fell 34% to 3.3 TWh, mainly because of lower wholesale sales.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Regional gas consumption decreased 7% to 7.0 TWh.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Results in maritime transport were affected by weaker demand, higher fuel prices, increased EU ETS emissions costs and geopolitical volatility.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Tallink carried 1.45 million passengers in Q2, down 2.2% year on year, while cargo units increased 2.9%.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Fuel costs rose by EUR 8.4 million, and Tallink’s EBITDA declined to EUR 34.3 million from EUR 37.4 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Total assets increased to EUR 2.71 billion from EUR 2.60 billion at year-end, while equity rose to EUR 1.20 billion.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Cash increased to EUR 253.2 million, and net debt declined to EUR 829.9 million from EUR 851.6 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: The Group invested approximately EUR 50 million during the first half.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Infortar increased its Tallink ownership to 68.76%, and no business combinations were completed in Q2.
